title: Aritra Partners, JSA act on Ethereal Machines $28.5 million Series B fundraise
description: Ethereal Machines Private Limited has raised $28.5 million from a Series B fundraise led by Avataar Venture Partners, with participation from existing investor Peak XV Partners, Novellus Systems Inc., and other investors.Aritra Partners advised Ethereal Machines. The Firm provided end-to-end support, acting as legal counsel and delivering tax advisory and comprehensive due diligence support.The transaction team consisted of Sadashiva NT (Managing Partner), Akshay Sai (Senior Manager), Rahul Roy
